gaps.sentence: She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.
This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
He suffers from ___ (SLEEP) since the accident.
